method.scope: all embedded-text blocks inside the repository ASCE body-content y-band
method.candidate_rule: existing ASCE section regex applied to normalized block text
method.collision_definition: same numeric locator recognized from more than one source block
method.typography_observation: first source span font family/style and size retained from PyMuPDF block dictionaries
method.interpretation_boundary: typography is measured evidence for declaration/source-role discrimination; it is not itself an authority classification

post_discriminator_replay.scope: explicit normative body source role, retained PDF pages 63 through 542 inclusive, inside the repository ASCE body-content y-band
post_discriminator_replay.declaration_rule: after explicit normative role qualification, numeric section candidates require first nonempty source span font suffix .B at 9.5 pt within 0.05 pt tolerance

finding: Numeric locator text alone is unsafe, but explicit normative source-role qualification followed by preserved first-span declaration typography resolves the measured declaration collision family conservatively. On the exact retained normative body replay, all 808 promoted declarations have unique locators and no duplicate declaration family remains; regular, italic, bold-italic, missing, and size-mismatched candidates fail closed.
next_gate: Keep source-role authority separate from declaration typography. Any future expansion must add exact-source evidence and regressions before widening the accepted declaration family.
